entities.name: PMID:27506200
observations: 2016 study introduced tissue-specific BirA/Avi in vivo biotinylation with affinity purification–mass spectrometry in C. elegans.
DLG-1 purification identified candidate partners ATAD-3 and MAPH-1.1; ATAD-3 interaction was mechanistically validated, while MAPH-1.1 was proposed as a neuron-specific candidate.

entities.name: ATAD-3
observations: Identified as a candidate DLG-1 interactor by tissue-specific affinity purification/mass spectrometry; interaction domains were mapped and the interaction contributed to C. elegans development.

entities.name: MAPH-1.1
observations: Co-purified specifically with neuronal DLG-1 and was characterized as a microtubule-associated MAP1-family protein; proposed as a neuron-specific DLG-1 interaction partner.

entities.name: DLG-1
observations: C. elegans Discs large protein purified using tissue-specific BirA/Avi biotinylation and AP/MS to identify tissue-dependent interaction partners.
